subject: cock-standards
q: CLOSED — the 1.5-inch rule was never broken, only over-applied.
detail: The rule is conditional: it governs a pairing only where an Anchor is present, and Anchor means the anchoring role rather than the Pillar printed on the profile. Bryn to Torie is the 1.5-inch exemplar. Lumina and Abbi retain their independently authored 10.2 and 8.5 values, a 1.7-inch gap. Luna to Alice and Livi to Rae were never in scope, and their gaps are chosen. A Chaos Agent may also contest the figure, at which point it converts to a floor — see the Contested Floor.
